name: kubiq-icons
description: Reference for Kubiq's icon set — the registry in assets/icons/icons.yaml, the SVG spec every icon obeys, how GPUI draws and tints one, and the draw-render-review loop for adding icons without the set drifting. Use when adding, redrawing or renaming an icon, when a concept needs a glyph it does not have, or when running just icons-check / icons-sheet / icons-audit.
